# runtime-catalog

The closed list of conversation runtimes (`CONVERSATION_RUNTIMES`: `tmux`,
`sdk`) as plain data — id, label, description, and how the terminal button
attaches (`interactive` / `read-only`). A leaf both halves read: the runtime
registry types its ids by it, the default-runtime config and the Runtime launch
option list it, the terminal pane reads `terminal` off it. A leaf so the launch
option (which `conversations` reads) and `conversations` itself never import
each other.
